Colleagues, suggest making following clarifications to have more correct references in introduction part of [V6.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x15-V6-Authentication.md#v63-general-authentication-security):

from 

> This could include device-bound passkeys, eIDAS LoA3 enforced authenticators, authenticators with AAL3 assurance, or an equivalent mechanism.

to 

> This could include device-bound passkeys, eIDAS **Levels of Assurance (LoA) High** enforced authenticators, authenticators with **NIST Authenticator Assurance Level 3** (AAL3) assurance, or an equivalent mechanism.

Regarding eIDAS there are no numbered levels, only Low, Substantial and High [eIDAS Levels of Assurance](https://ec.europa.eu/digital-building-blocks/sites/display/DIGITAL/eIDAS+Levels+of+Assurance).

Colleagues, suggest making following clarifications to have more correct references in introduction part of [V6.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x15-V6-Authentication.md#v63-general-authentication-security):

from 

> This could include device-bound passkeys, eIDAS LoA3 enforced authenticators, authenticators with AAL3 assurance, or an equivalent mechanism.

to 

> This could include device-bound passkeys, eIDAS **Level of Assurance (LoA) High** enforced authenticators, authenticators with **NIST Authenticator Assurance Level 3** (AAL3) assurance, or an equivalent mechanism.

Regarding eIDAS, it seems, there are no numbered levels, only Low, Substantial and High. And High level involves hardware-based authentication ([eIDAS Levels of Assurance](https://ec.europa.eu/digital-building-blocks/sites/display/DIGITAL/eIDAS+Levels+of+Assurance)).

from 

> This could include device-bound passkeys, eIDAS LoA3 enforced authenticators, authenticators with AAL3 assurance, or an equivalent mechanism.

to 

> This could include device-bound passkeys, eIDAS **Level of Assurance (LoA) High** enforced authenticators, authenticators with **NIST Authenticator Assurance Level 3** (AAL3) assurance, or an equivalent mechanism.

Regarding eIDAS, it seems, there are no numbered levels, only Low, Substantial and High. And High level involves hardware-based authentication ([eIDAS Levels of Assurance](https://ec.europa.eu/digital-building-blocks/sites/display/DIGITAL/eIDAS+Levels+of+Assurance)). Also checked in full EU [Regulation No 910/2014](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32024R1183&qid=1716986198888) on establishing the European Digital Identity Framework.
